scope.summary: Implement trusted, auditable reconciliation of Copilot-generated PR auto-close footers and rerun the unchanged Verify gate against the sanitized current PR body.
implemented: Trusted eligibility-checked PR description reconciliation with bounded repairs and audit diagnostics.
Post-creation canonical evidence markers in controller-generated descriptions; recovered PR bodies remain untouched.
Explicit rerun of the matching Verify run and live PR body/head validation in existing evidence guards.

criteria.description: An incomplete Copilot PR is not failed **solely** because the generated body appended an auto-close footer; the footer is corrected/removed before final evidence validation, with audit visibility.

evidence.reference: tests/agent-evidence-pr-description.test.mjs: valid partial PR loses only its trailing auto-close footer
evidence.outcome: Passes: sanitizer removes the footer and requests Verify rerun for the matching PR head.

criteria.description: Required `Refs #N` and matching canonical markers survive Copilot PR-body rewrites; a PR without actual required evidence is still blocked until the evidence exists and is valid.

evidence.reference: tests/agent-evidence-pr-description.test.mjs: marker restoration and missing-evidence cases; tools/agent-controller/listener.test.mjs: post-creation evidence marker cases
evidence.outcome: Passes: marker paths are tied to the actual PR and existing evidence pair; missing or malformed evidence is not fabricated.

criteria.description: Tests prove no editing loops, no unauthorized PR edits, and fail-closed behavior for malformed/uncertain issue links and API errors.

evidence.outcome: 31 evidence/reconciliation tests pass, including repeat repairs, unrelated PRs, ambiguity, concurrent edits, API/rate-limit errors, and idempotency.

criteria.description: Existing hard evidence, security, database and merge protections remain enforced; new automation cannot cause premature issue closure.

evidence.outcome: Existing evidence gate and Verify/database workflows remain enabled; both evidence guards now reject stale PR heads and read current metadata.
Verify failed closed at the missing-marker gate before later steps; no evidence or merge protection was bypassed.

criteria.description: Real-world demonstration on a fresh Copilot draft PR plus later Copilot description update, with required Verify passing when legitimate evidence is present, and actual feature tests unchanged.

evidence.outcome: Blocked until the trusted workflow is merged and can run on a fresh draft and subsequent Copilot body update.

tests.result: ESLint passed on changed JavaScript files.

decisions: Keep the evidence and database gates intact; a repaired PR body must still pass existing checks.
Do not close or auto-merge Issue #278; retain the PR as draft until human review and the live demonstration are complete.
limitations: The trusted reconciliation workflow is not active until merged to copilot/Development; actual Copilot reappend/rewrite behavior has not been demonstrated.
The current PR body lacks top-level canonical markers, so Verify fails before test/build steps.
GitHub's PR update API does not provide an atomic compare-and-swap; the workflow mitigates but cannot eliminate a narrow concurrent edit race.
The independent PR coordination check failed with an undefined replaceAll error and was not modified.
blockers: Replace the current PR body with canonical Refs and issue/evidence markers, then rerun the required Verify checks.
Complete a fresh-draft and later-description-update demonstration after the trusted workflow is active.
